product.title: Tank Commander
product.summary: Compete or tank each month, against lottery odds that barely reward it.
product.whatStudentsDo: Students choose to compete or tank month by month through a rebuilding season while real draft-lottery odds shift, discovering that the worst record buys only a small edge and that tanking too obviously invites investigation.
product.technology: single-file HTML/CSS/JS with a grade-band toggle

studentDataProfile.notes: State kept in browser localStorage only; no server call observed.

governance.maturityBasis: A complete short-format experience built around a genuine incentive-design idea. Not deployed, and no student-run evidence exists.

health.technicalBasis: No deployment found for this repo (GitHub Pages 404).
knownBlockers: No deployment — an instructor cannot run it today.

provenance.evidence: BSC-anythingelse/public/tank-commander.html notes the 'worst team only has 14% chance at #1' and 'The difference between 14% and 8% is small. Extreme tanking isn't guaranteed to pay off.'
